newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China non-ferrous metal corporation to restructure.
newsitem.headline: China non-ferrous metal corporation to restructure.

text.p: China National Non-ferrous Metals Industry Corp (CNNC) will create a separate holding company to make production in China's metals industry more efficient, the firm's vice president said on Monday.

"Very soon, CNNC will establish a holding company which will take shape in three years," Chen Shengnian told reporters after his opening address at the China non-ferrous metals fair being held in Hong Kong this week.
The holding company would be supported by CNNC, the highest government entity overseeing China's non-ferrous metals production, and would help improve efficiency, Chen said.
"If the result is good, then we will persist, if the result is not so good, then we will study it again," Chen said.
CNNC would also tighten its methods for obtaining regular supplies of raw materials, Chen said.
"CNNC must change its trading methods," Chen said.
In the past, China would buy on the international market as and when the need arose, Chen said.

"Now we must think long term," he said, noting that China would try and find stable suppliers of raw material for more long term arrangements. CNNC had to place emphasis on both production and marketing, Chen said.
